title: LibScript Unified Node & Sysroot Trait Specification
description: Declarative contract defining composable cross-cutting traits that orchestrate _lib components across both Tier 2 offline sysroot image baking and Tier 3 live node execution.

id.description: Unique identifier for the trait (e.g. storage, secrets, firewall, mesh, discovery, ingress, tls, logging, metrics, backup, maintenance)

category.description: Functional classification category of the trait

priority.description: Deterministic execution order priority (lower numbers run first: storage=10, secrets=20, mesh=30, firewall=40, discovery=50, tls=60, ingress=70, logging=80, metrics=90, backup=100, maintenance=110)

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the trait's responsibilities and delegated _lib components

delegates_to.description: List of underlying _lib components or common utilities composed by this trait

items.description: Relative path or component identifier in _lib/

execution_modes.description: Dual-mode execution capability flags for Tier 2 offline sysroots vs Tier 3 live hosts

supports_offline_sysroot_bake.description: Whether the trait can pre-bake static configurations into LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_SYSROOT during offline OS image synthesis without live kernel syscalls

supports_live_runtime.description: Whether the trait can execute live mutations and service reloads on a running Tier 3 host

os_support.description: Operating system kernel compatibility matrix for this trait

linux.description: Supported on Linux kernels (glibc and musl)

windows.description: Supported natively on Windows (or via Option A proforma boundary)

win32_boundary.description: Behavior of the .cmd implementation on Windows: native execution or Option A hard-fail with exit code 86 when Linux/Unix kernel primitives are required
